commands.name: pull_and_quant_and_inventory_flow
commands.command: MLX_STACK_HOME=/tmp/mlx-stack-user-testing/tooling-g1 uv run mlx-stack pull/config/models flows (gemma3-4b int4/int8/fp32 + low-disk image test)

assertionResults.reason: `pull gemma3-4b --quant int4` created model directory under isolated models dir with expected files.
Default quant from config was used (`int8`), explicit `--quant int4` override was honored, and invalid quant `fp32` was rejected with valid values.
Using a temporary 600MB mounted disk image as model-dir caused pull to fail pre-download with required vs available disk space details.
CLI showed download start lines, but this environment completed transfers via `hf` without granular progress percentages/rates, so continuous progress updates could not be conclusively observed.
Re-running pull for existing int4 model reported already exists and suggested `--force` without re-downloading.
Successful pulls updated `models.json` and models listing reflected downloaded model metadata.

frictions.description: Catalog small model `qwen3.5-0.8b` repository no longer exists publicly; switched validation to `gemma3-4b`.
frictions.resolution: Validated assertions with an available catalog model to continue user-surface testing.

blockers.description: Progress-bar style updates were not emitted by underlying HF CLI in this run, limiting observability for VAL-PULL-005.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Captured full stdout from pull commands and retried with multiple model pulls; only start/finish lines were emitted.
